jobs.description:
Embedded Software Engineer - Radar team
Do you want to work at the forefront of technology, where your creativity and ideas directly shape the next generation of intelligent surveillance? As an Embedded Software Engineer in our Radar team, you'll help develop world-leading radar and sensor fusion solutions that make a real difference. This is a permanent, full-time role based on-site at our headquarters in Lund, Sweden.
Who is your future team?
You'll join a small, supportive team of four dedicated software engineers. We value different perspectives, continuous learning and open collaboration. We work closely with colleagues in electronics, mechanics, software, signal processing and graphics to take innovative products from concept to market.
Our recent work includes advanced radar analytics, precise speed measurement and intelligent algorithms that keep improving for our users. We have also developed new ways of combining radar with PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) cameras, which enables powerful automated tracking. We build everything from standalone radar systems to integrated platforms that solve real-world surveillance challenges.
What you'll do here as Embedded Software Engineer
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll play an essential part in developing our new radar products. You'll work across the whole embedded Linux stack, so you'll see your contributions in everything from low-level drivers to the features our customers use every day. You will:
Be part of our product development team, building the next generation of radar products
Analyze, design and write software for features in our upcoming products
Find and fix issues wherever they occur, from Linux kernel drivers to applications

Who are we looking for?
You're curious and interested in technology, and you enjoy tackling challenges together with your team. You take initiative and do well in a workplace built on openness, creativity, trust, commitment, playfulness and encouragement.
As your closest manager, I will support your personal development, give you freedom and trust, and guide you in your career. - Peter Wahlberg, Engineering Manager
We'd love to hear that you have:
A couple of years of professional experience developing software in C++, or equivalent experience
Experience with Linux
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Bonus points for:
Experience with low-level programming on Linux
Experience programming FPGAs

What Axis has to offer
At Axis, you'll have the freedom to explore different technical areas, grow your skills, and shape your own career path. We offer a flexible work environment, opportunities for professional development, and the chance to work with cutting-edge technology in a global company.
To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
Life at Axis blog 
Engineering at Axis blog 
Innovation at Axis 
Ready to act?
Axis knows the value of a diverse workforce. Diversity in teams creates a better working environment and encourages creativity, which is fundamental to our success. We welcome all applications. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.
If you have questions, please contact the recruiting manager, Peter Wahlberg, Engineering Manager, at 0701710068.
We review applications continuously, so don't wait. Apply today and help us build the future of intelligent surveillance!
This recruitment is handled solely by Axis Communications AB. We politely but firmly decline all contact from recruitment and consulting companies.

jobs.occupation: Test Lead ABB Process Control Platform
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Cluster Manager CION.
Do you want to shape the future of industrial automation and quality assurance?
At ABB, we're developing the next generation of our world-leading Process Control Platform, used by customers across a wide range of industries worldwide. As a Test Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of a global product developed in Malmö and deployed across ABB's Process Automation portfolio.
You will lead a growing team of test engineers and drive the development of advanced automated testing solutions for a highly complex technology environment. This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for leadership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Your role and responsibilities
Lead and develop the PIT (Product Integration Test) team, currently consisting of 6-7 engineers and expected to grow.
Drive the development of automated test solutions for both embedded controllers and engineering components.
Oversee testing of backend services, advanced engineering tools and editors, communication layers, software libraries, and complex platform functionality.
Ensure quality and coverage for critical areas such as redundancy, hot swap capabilities, cybersecurity, safety, performance, and system stability.
Lead the continued development of the PIT test framework, a platform developed in Malmö and intended for global use across ABB.
Report test progress, quality metrics, and overall test status to development projects and stakeholders.
Plan and coordinate test activities within the team while acting as Scrum Master.
Define, implement, and continuously improve the test strategy and test processes.
Collaborate closely with other testing organizations and development teams within Process Control Platform R&D to ensure a consistent quality approach.

Qualifications for the role
Proven experience as a Test Lead or in a similar test leadership role within software and hardware development.
Experience testing physical products and systems in complex technical environments.
A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Hands-on experience with automated testing and test frameworks.
Strong knowledge of containerized environments, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps.
Experience with scripting and basic software development.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English.

More about us
We develop today's and tomorrow's world-leading DCS (Distributed Control System) for process industries all over the world. Our customers include the pharmaceutical industry, mines, refineries, steel mills and power plants. 
Recruiting Manager Mårten Svensson, +46 725 887 121 will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Hakan J. Gustavsson, +46 72 230 10 93; Ledarna: Leif Öhrberg, +46 724 644 016; Unionen: Mikael Hammar, +46 730 887 060. All other questions can be directed to Talent Partner Irma Leijon, +46 724 612 314. 
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
Ready to make an impact?
Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

What you'll do:
Help shape the future of healthcare AI, where innovation meets trust.

At CERN, you will develop cutting-edge AI solutions that help prevent disease, improve prediction, and deliver trustworthy healthcare insights. You will work on technologies that make it possible to unlock the value of sensitive data without ever moving or exposing it, enabling collaboration where privacy is essential.

As part of this role, you will help develop and deploy CAFEIN, CERN's federated AI platform powering major European healthcare initiatives, including UMBRELLA and AIM-SAFE. You will design advanced federated learning algorithms and secure distributed AI systems that allow models to learn from data across institutions while keeping the data exactly where it belongs.

Recognised as a lighthouse example of "data stays, AI collaborates", CAFEIN combines state-of-the-art federated learning with CERN's unique strengths in trust, open science, GDPR compliance, and international collaboration. The result is a pioneering framework that is redefining how AI can advance healthcare while safeguarding privacy.

Join us to build AI that learns globally, protects locally, and improves lives.

Your responsibilities: 
- Develop and test federated learning software and algorithms.
- Implement and evaluate privacy-preserving techniques, including differential privacy and homomorphic encryption.
- Develop tools to optimise data ingestions and assess the quality of data and images.
- Design and run machine-learning experiments using programming languages like Python with libraries asTensorFLow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
- Analyse data using statistical methods and visualisation for exploratory data analysis (EDA).
- Implement and benchmark state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, optimising federated learning for utility, communication efficiency, energy use and scalability.
- Design and deploy Internet of Things (IoT)-based federated learning architectures.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience developing and deploying federated learning solutions in real-world environments.
- Proficiency in federated learning techniques, including aggregation algorithms, communication and network architecture, security and privacy features.
- Hands on experience with network security, including certificates, encryption, access control, authorisation, and authentication.
- Proven experience in coordinating or technically leading machine-learning deployments.
- Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with software life-cycle tools and procedures (proficiency with Git and GitLab).
- Excellent knowledge of programming techniques and languages: Python, deep learning framework (e.g. TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Jax or scikit-learn).
- Experience in data analysis in a health care environment would be an asset.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Machine Learning, Computer Science or Data Science or a related field.

Your Skills: 
- Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.
- Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.
- Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software.
- Knowledge of best practices for developing secure software.
- Administration of computing systems, upgrades, application of security patches, system and data migrations, backup and recovery.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, taking action to address them; delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Cooperates constructively with others in the pursuit of team goals; balances personal goals with team goals.
- Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
- Shares knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaches others to ensure knowledge transfer.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a Senior Oracle PL/SQL Developer for a long-term consulting assignment within a complex, business-critical IT environment. The consultant will join an experienced team responsible for the development and maintenance of databases and backend solutions.
This is a hands-on development role with a strong focus on Oracle PL/SQL, database-centric business logic, and transaction-intensive systems. The environment handles large data volumes, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows, with demanding requirements for stability, performance, and availability. A significant portion of the business logic is implemented directly in the database through SQL and stored procedures. Microservices developed in Java and .NET operate above the database layer and communicate with different business functions and external systems.
The position is specifically focused on Oracle PL/SQL development and business logic. It is not a traditional database administrator role and does not focus on Data Warehousing or Business Intelligence.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and enhance database functionality and business logic using Oracle PL/SQL and SQL.
Design and maintain stored procedures and other database-centric application components.
Troubleshoot database code and resolve issues in complex, transaction-intensive backend systems.
Analyze and optimize database performance across large-scale Oracle environments.
Work with high-volume data processing, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows.
Develop and maintain integrations and data flows between databases, microservices, external partners, and connected systems.
Collaborate closely with senior developers and architects on technical solutions, system enhancements, and improvements to existing platforms.
Understand complex business processes and translate functional requirements into reliable database-level implementations.
Contribute ideas, technical improvements, and knowledge sharing within a senior, international engineering team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Database platform: Extensive, current hands-on experience with Oracle Database and PL/SQL development.
Database programming: Advanced SQL skills, including stored procedures and database-centric programming.
Performance: Experience troubleshooting and optimizing code in large database environments with stringent performance and availability requirements.
Backend architecture: Experience working with complex, transaction-intensive backend systems and high-volume data processing.
Microservices: Understanding of microservices architecture and backend services developed with Java or .NET is advantageous.
Integrations: Experience implementing data flows and integrations with external partners and systems is advantageous.
Business systems: Experience with billing platforms, CRM solutions, or other business-critical transaction systems is beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience
The successful consultant will have substantial and recent practical experience in Oracle PL/SQL development, together with a strong understanding of SQL, stored procedures, business logic, and transaction flows. Experience diagnosing technical issues, improving performance, and solving problems in large Oracle environments is required. The role also requires the ability to work independently, take initiative, and quickly understand complex technical environments and interconnected business systems.
Previous experience in banking, financial services, energy, or another transaction-intensive industry is advantageous. The consultant should be comfortable collaborating with experienced developers and architects while contributing to technical discussions and continuous system improvement. Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.

jobs.occupation: Client Service Associate (Dutch) Build a Career in Finance (London)
jobs.description:
Are you a Dutch speaker looking for an opportunity to develop professionally, learn new skills and build a long-term career within the financial services industry?
Our client, a leading international investment management company, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Dutch Client Service Associate to join their growing team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working behind the scenes, supporting clients and business operations, and is eager to grow within an international organisation. No finance background is required – what matters most is your motivation, willingness to learn and ambition to develop.
The Role
As a Client Service Associate, you will play an important role in supporting the company's daily operations and ensuring a high level of service for its Dutch-speaking clients.
This is primarily a back-office and administrative role, involving collaboration with different teams and financial institutions across Europe.
Your responsibilities will include:
Handling administrative and operational tasks in collaboration with leading banks and financial institutions.
Supporting internal teams with client-related inquiries and daily operations.
Preparing reports and maintaining accurate client information.
Working closely with colleagues across different departments and European markets.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and contribute new ideas.
Gradually taking on additional responsibilities as you develop within the role.

Career Development
What makes this opportunity particularly interesting is the potential for long-term career growth.
Our client believes in developing talent from within and offers comprehensive training, ongoing support and opportunities to explore different career paths across the business.
You will be encouraged to take initiative, develop new skills and take on greater responsibilities as you progress. Whether your future interests lie in operations, management, analytics or other areas of the business, there are opportunities to shape your own career path.
Our client wants you to grow with the company and chart a course for a rewarding, long-term career.
Your Profile
We are looking for someone who is motivated, organised and genuinely interested in the position and the opportunity it offers.
To be successful in this role, you should have:
Native or fluent Dutch and good English skills, both written and spoken.
A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong communication and organisational skills.
A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to work well within a team.
A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.
An interest in building a long-term career within an international business environment.

A background in finance, economics or business is an advantage but not a requirement.
The Offer
Full-time, permanent position.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
A collaborative and international working environment.
Excellent opportunities for internal career progression.
The chance to build a rewarding, long-term career within a growing international organisation.

Location: London, United Kingdom (office-based).
Interested?
If you are a Dutch speaker looking for more than just your next job, and are excited about the opportunity to learn, develop and grow within an international company, we would love to hear from you!
Apply today and take the next step towards building your future career.

Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for an experienced Back-End Developer to join our IAM engineering team in Stockholm, developing products for authentication, identity management and digital signing.
Working alongside experienced engineers, architects and product specialists, you will contribute to the continued evolution of established software products used by organisations across the public and private sectors.
About Clavister
Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI for customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. With our partners and distributors, our hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.
The role
As a Back-End Developer in our IAM team, you will design, develop and maintain Java-based server-side software that supports secure authentication, identity management and digital signing.
You will work with established products that continue to evolve as customer needs, security requirements and technology change. This means balancing new functionality with reliability, performance, maintainability and technical debt.
You will be part of a collaborative engineering team where technical discussions, shared ownership and continuous improvement are important parts of everyday work.
Key responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain Java-based backend services and applications.

Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions.

Develop secure, reliable and maintainable software with a focus on long-term product quality.

Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, including performance and reliability challenges.

Identify and address technical debt while balancing new development with improvements to existing products.

Collaborate with engineers, architects, Product Management and Customer Success to deliver customer value.

Contribute to engineering practices such as code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvement.

To thrive in this role we believe you have
Several years of professional experience in Java backend development and a strong understanding of the Java ecosystem.

Experience developing asynchronous or concurrent software.

Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.

Familiarity with both Windows and Linux environments.

An understanding of software design, maintainability and quality.

A collaborative mindset, curiosity and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges.

Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Extra points for
Experience with IAM, authentication, authorisation, identity management or digital signing solutions.

Experience designing and developing complex enterprise software products.

Familiarity with security-related technologies, protocols or integrations.

Frontend development experience using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript or React.

What we offer
Meaningful work developing cybersecurity products that protect digital identities and critical services.

The opportunity to work with experienced engineers on technically challenging, established software products.

A collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning are encouraged.

The opportunity to influence technical solutions and contribute to the long-term evolution of our IAM portfolio.

A supportive team culture that values work–life balance and sustainable software development.

Join us
If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, developing reliable software and contributing to products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.
The position is based in Stockholm. We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

Job Description
Join our dynamic project team to handle electrical and optical connections in our test facilities at HVDC. 
You will be involved in testing the control and protection systems for our HVDC systems and contribute to our development efforts. This role offers opportunities to work abroad and requires responsibility for electrical works and ensuring electrical safety in assigned projects within our test facility.

jobs.occupation: PHINIA Sweden AB (fd SEM AB) söker en projektledare
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Lead and coordinate multiple automotive projects and engineering change initiatives from development through production launch, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, customers, and stakeholders to manage project plans, resources, risks, and business objectives while driving successful product launches and continuous improvement.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead multiple/parallel projects and engineering change requests according to plant necessity.
Develop project plans (project scope, timeline, cost, resources, risk, quality, communication and procurement) then lead and deploy overall project timing to the team.
Coordinate the cross functional teams, to develop and implement plans to fit within timeline and key milestones.
Conduct regular project team meetings and ensure teams are accountable for their deliverables and timeline, managing risk escalation and resolution.
Support customer meetings and support all functional discussion at customer.
Manage and track all prototype phases A: alpha, B: betta, C: gamma up to and including PPAP, followed by production ramp up tracking and serial life.
Lead and apply PDP process, PDP Gate reviews and support engineering to run PDP design reviews
Create and update Project Online reporting – identify, analyze, resolve and/or escalate risks in a timely manner.
Support BU initiative for tracking flawless launch of all product programs.
Support and where appropriate lead in production activities as per our change management process.
Be positive, encourage, coach & share knowledge with all cross functional teams.
Communicate effectively, develop and conduct regular presentations to the customers and PHINIA management.
Lead preparation for regular project business case updates and ensure purchased costs, capex, volume, pricing, and engineering costs are collected and supplied to finance for consolidation in the business case.
Where a project business case is not meeting the defined targets lead the teams for cost improvement activities and drive recovery plans.
Facilitate collaboration among team members from sample team and from cross functional teams to encourage efficiency.
Manage resource allocation effectively to optimize team productivity.

Essential
Minimum 5 years of experience in a team management and coordination role within the automotive industry.
Strong understanding of project management planning, methodologies, and best practices.
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and project management skills.
Ability to plan, structure, and execute projects effectively while managing timelines and resources.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and guide teams toward common objectives.
Proven track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget.
 Advanced level of English.

Desirable.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Business Administration.
Additional experience managing complex cross-functional projects.
Experience working in a manufacturing or automotive product development environment.
Strong analytical capabilities and continuous improvement

PHINIA is a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGE TM. PHINIA designs systems to keep combustion engines operating at peak performance across a variety of applications, including light passenger vehicle, commercial vehicle, and off-highway, industrial and other applications, while investing in alternative fuels to support lower carbon mobility.

Are you a test engineer with great interest in technology and products? Are you curious about software solutions, including network and devices? Now you have the opportunity to work as team test engineer in the product area Video Management Systems (VMS) at Axis HQ in Lund.
 
Who is your future team?
You will work at ACS Pro Test, which is responsible for testing Axis' proprietary VMS Axis Camera Station Pro. This Windows product is an important part of Axis' end-to-end solutions for video surveillance. You can find more information here: https://www.axis.com/products/axis-camera-station-pro
 
What you'll do here as a QA Engineer for Axis Camera Station Pro?
The development and testing of Axis Camera Station Pro is divided into several agile teams including both developers and testers. The team testing role we are about to fill is for a team that focuses on APIs and communication protocols.
 
Some of the responsibilities are:
* Plan and execute short term manual test needs based on new functionality together with the team
* Develop automated tests for the technical area 
* Participate in release testing for the complete solution
* Lead the work to set up and maintain good test environments for both automated and manual testing covering the team's needs
* Participate in improvement work related to working methods, test strategy, automation, and test environments
 
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for you who have experience in software testing and have good knowledge of agile development methods. We believe that you have a master's or bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent and have programming skills, preferably in Python and/or C#. You have previous experience of testing at different levels, manual and automated testing, functional and non-functional testing. You have experience of working with systems crossing the borders of software, hardware and network.
 
As a person, you are open, curious, structured and have a strong interest in both customer perspective and technology. You cooperate and communicate smoothly with others in both Swedish and English, you take initiative, and you have a good eye for details.
 
What Axis have to offer

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer - ATLAS ITk Pixel Detector
jobs.description:
What you'll do
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing.

As a mechanical engineer in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment on the design, construction and installation of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer System.

Your responsibilities
-Design of precision tooling for the integration, testing and installation of the ITk Pixel Outer System Detector, comprising the Outer Barrel, Endcaps and Inner System Support Tube.
-Design and develop service installation procedures and tooling, including temporary service management solutions for testing of the ITk Pixel Detector.
-Verify the design of components and tooling according to the relevant standards and best engineering practices, performing both, analytical and numerical calculations.
-Develop, document and implement tools and procedures for integration and installation of detector components and services.
-Participate hands-on in the detector integration work in the ATLAS SR1 cleanroom as well as the preparation on surface and in the cavern for the installation.
-Prepare technical specifications for components and tools, following up their production, acceptance and installation.
-Support preparation of and participate in the ATLAS ID detector extraction.

Your profile
-Proven experience in the design of precision mechanical components and assembly tools for complex systems.
-Demonstrated experience in the use of CAD software for 3D modelling and management of large assemblies. Proficiency in Catia V5 would be a plus.
-Demonstrated experience in the production of 2D technical drawings according to the relevant standards for dimensioning and tolerances (e.g. ISO Geometrical Product Specifications, GPS).
-Proven hands-on experience in the construction and testing of mechanical systems.
-Demonstrated experience drafting technical specifications, assembly procedures and engineering reports.
-Experience with assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment is advantageous.
-Experience with structural joining techniques, particularly orbital welding is advantageous.
-Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
-Design and analysis of mechanical structures.
-Production of 2D drawings and 3D models (ISO dimensioning, tolerancing).
-Integration of mechanical systems.
-Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.
-Knowledge and application of joining techniques, welding.
-Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
-Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements, adopting a pragmatic approach. Understands the value of adopting generic rather than 'gold -plated' technical solutions.
-Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships, but also works well autonomously. Takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
-Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
A valid driving licence.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Autocom is a high-tech company that develops advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicles. Our end customers include vehicle repair shops and inspection companies. Our Autocom products are available in most European countries, and we work with several major companies worldwide in the automotive aftermarket. Our economic growth is stable, which allows us to continue to hire new employees, and we currently have around 120 employees. Autocom is part of the Würth Group, which has over 90,000 employees globally. More information about AUTOCOM can be found at www.autocom.se.

About the role
As a Data Solutions Engineer, you will work with complex vehicle data and build reliable data flows that turn fragmented information into structured, high-quality data for our diagnostic products. You will work across the entire data flow, from ingestion and transformation to validation and delivery, with a strong focus on data quality, automation and scalable solutions.
You will play an important role in developing and maintaining the data pipelines that form the foundation of our diagnostic products. This position combines hands-on development with problem-solving and continuous improvement and you will work independently on technical solutions while collaborating closely with software developers, data developers and other teams across the organization.
Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.

Working with data ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery.

Ensuring data quality through automated testing and monitoring.

Identifying and resolving data errors, anomalies and pipeline issues.

Automating manual and repetitive data management processes.

Contributing to data modelling and cloud-based data solutions.

Translating technical requirements and vehicle protocols into reliable and useful datasets together with software developers, data developers and other stakeholders.

What you bring
We are looking for someone with solid experience in software development, data engineering or data solutions, who is comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation. You enjoy working hands-on and solving technical problems, while also being able to step back, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute your own ideas on technical solutions and ways of working.
A relevant university degree is an advantage, but your professional experience will be the most important factor.
We believe you have:

Solid experience in programming and software development, for example Python.

Experience working with data management, data transformation and/or data pipelines.

Experience working with structured data such as XML, JSON and APIs.

The ability to independently drive technical solutions and take ownership of your work.

Good Swedish and English skills, both spoken and written.

As a person, you are self-motivated, proactive and communicative. You take ownership and enjoy driving things forward, while contributing your own ideas on how technical solutions and processes can be improved. You work in a structured and quality-focused way and enjoy collaborating with people with different areas of expertise.
Application
In this recruitment process, Autocom is collaborating with Skill. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Johan Zizala at Skill, johan.zizala@skill.se / 0721-43 93 42.

ALTEN is seeking an engaged Embedded Developer to join our team in Sweden. You will work with a leading client in the Automotive industry, focusing on Driver Interaction systems in a hybrid setup. A chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative projects

A dynamic and collaborative work environment

Opportunities for professional growth and career development

A role where you can make a real impact in the Automotive industry

The developed code will be integrated into the Instrument Cluster (Driver Information Module), which runs on a dual-processor architecture—one for AUTOSAR and another for Linux/Yocto with Qt.

You will collaborate in a Scrum team of around 6 people, including a dedicated Product Owner and Scrum Master. Communication protocols like CAN, LIN, and Ethernet (SOME/IP, STOMP, display sharing) will be part of your daily work.

Develop Embedded C code for core logic in Driver Interaction systems

Implement HMI visualization using C++/Qt

Work with AUTOSAR and ensure compliance with ISO 26262 requirements

Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum team to define and realize driver interaction features

Integrate and test software on a dual-processor architecture (AUTOSAR + Linux/Yocto)

Utilize communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet (SOME/IP, STOMP)

Participate in continuous integration and automated regression testing

Your profile

We are looking for a fast-learning, curious, and team-oriented developer with a strong background in Embedded C, AUTOSAR, and ISO 26262.

Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field

Proven experience in Embedded C development

Hands-on experience with AUTOSAR and ISO 26262 implementation

Experience with HMI development and driver interaction systems

Familiarity with C++/Qt for visualization

Fluent in English (Swedish is a plus)

About ALTEN

ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences.
